changelog: In-app updater (Platforms: `L`)**: check GitHub for the latest release and download updates from within the app.
Safe update staging**: updates download to `<DOWNLOAD_DIR>/app_update/` and apply on next launch; keeps a single `.bak` backup for rollback.
HTTPS + redirect support (switch-curl)**: updater and GitHub asset downloads work over HTTPS with redirects to CDN.
Stability fixes**: improved shutdown hygiene around updater/network/logging to avoid hbmenu instability after using the updater.
More robust update validation**: better detection/diagnostics for bad payloads, plus correct NRO magic handling.
